script_head_40:
#!/bin/sh
set -e
# Docker CE for Linux installation script (Rootless mode)
#
# See https://docs.docker.com/go/rootless/ for the
# installation steps.
#
# This script is meant for quick & easy install via:
#   $ curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com/rootless -o get-docker.sh
#   $ sh get-docker.sh
#
# NOTE: Make sure to verify the contents of the script
#       you downloaded matches the contents of rootless-install.sh
#       located at https://github.com/docker/docker-install
#       before executing.
#
# Git commit from https://github.com/docker/docker-install when
# the script was uploaded (Should only be modified by upload job):
SCRIPT_COMMIT_SHA="5ce20f2eef3615d08fea941eda5a109e949e8ebf"

# This script should be run with an unprivileged user and install/setup Docker under $HOME/bin/.

# latest version available in the stable channel.
STABLE_LATEST="29.7.1"

# latest version available in the test channel.
TEST_LATEST="29.7.1"

# The channel to install from:
#   * test
#   * stable
DEFAULT_CHANNEL_VALUE="stable"
if [ -z "$CHANNEL" ]; then
	CHANNEL=$DEFAULT_CHANNEL_VALUE
fi

STATIC_RELEASE_URL=
STATIC_RELEASE_ROOTLESS_URL=

# static_release_url returns the download URL for a given package and version.

newuidmap: echo "newuidmap binary not found. Please install with a package manager."
subuid: # validate subuid/subgid files for current user
>&2 echo "Could not find records for the current user $(id -un) from /etc/subuid . Please make sure valid subuid range is set there.
>&2 echo "Could not find records for the current user $(id -un) from /etc/subgid . Please make sure valid subuid range is set there.
subgid: # validate subuid/subgid files for current user
>&2 echo "Could not find records for the current user $(id -un) from /etc/subgid . Please make sure valid subuid range is set there.

install_skip_reason: Official rootless Docker setup requires subordinate uid/gid ranges; /etc/subuid and /etc/subgid have no current-user range >=65536. Contract says stop with ROOTLESS_DOCKER_PREREQUISITE_BLOCKED rather than perform a misleading partial install.
